explain: An agent definition connects instructions, tool contracts, model adapter, and stop policy. This is a runtime-neutral configuration model, not an ADK constructor call.
steps: Register a narrowly described tool and its expected argument. || Attach the tool set and budget to the agent configuration.
name: agent-definition

explain: functools.wraps preserves metadata and the inspectable wrapped signature while instrumentation surrounds the business function. Actual SDK registration remains in the chapter's integration example.
steps: Wrap the function without rebuilding its argument list. || Inspect the resulting callable's signature and call it normally.
name: function-signature

explain: A fixed workflow is sufficient when branching is known; durable state is a separate requirement from model-chosen tool use. The decision table keeps these reasons distinct.
steps: Declare the capability actually required. || Choose the implementation responsibility before selecting a library.
name: framework-fit
